rationale: Greek loanword ἀκαθαρσία 'impurity, uncleanness.' Lyc ⲫ for θ (regular orthographic feature). Standard moral-ritual term for impurity, here in plural ⲛⲁⲕⲁⲫⲁⲣⲥⲓⲁ as the impure things on/in which the regrowing flesh feeds.

Reduplicated form in line 16 between ⲙⲁⲩⲣⲱⲧ 'they do not grow' and ⲉⲧⲉ. Etymology unclear; possibly related to ⲱⲣ/ⲟⲩⲣ (turn, become) or a botanical action-verb. Confidence very low; flagged for parallel attestation in subsequent kephalaia.

Anomalous form on this page (line 2) for standard ⲡⲥⲱⲙⲁ 'the body.' Either a scribal slip (omission of ⲥ-) or a Lycopolitan dialectal variant ⲡⲉ-ⲱⲙⲁ. The translation 'the body' is required by the immediate parallel ⲡⲥⲱⲙⲁ in line 7. Worth flagging for further attestations to determine whether this is a recurring Lyc variant or unique scribal error.
